answer: Each submission needs cosignature from 3 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 7 submissions per epoch. Cosignatures are collected in ember, verified in nectar, and vine names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. The attacker spends 108 dollars and 1 days per identity before it can vote at all. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
